title: Thieves Guild Caravan Fence Quest
description: Tonilia asks the player to deliver moon sugar to Ri'saad, leader of the Khajiit caravans, to secure an alliance between the caravans and the Thieves Guild. Upon returning to Tonilia, the player receives leveled gold and three Khajiit become available as fences.

base_facts: I am the Thieves Guild's fence operating out of the Ragged Flagon.
I want to establish an alliance with the Khajiit caravans to transport Guild goods across Skyrim.

QUEST_STARTED: I have asked the player to deliver moon sugar to Ri'saad as a gift and to propose a partnership between the caravans and the Guild.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player secured the alliance with the Khajiit caravans. I rewarded them with gold.
Player returns to Tonilia and completes the quest, receiving gold and fence access.
The Khajiit do not become available as fences until after you have returned to Tonilia and finished the quest.
She requests that you speak to the leader of the caravans, a Khajiit peddler named Ri'saad about securing an alliance between the caravans and the Guild.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Khajiit caravans that travel between Whiterun and Markarth.
My caravan trades goods across Skyrim.

MOON_SUGAR_DELIVERED: I accepted the moon sugar and agreed to a partnership with the Thieves Guild.
My fellow Khajiit caravans will now buy stolen goods from Guild members.

beats.comment: Tonilia asks the player to deliver moon sugar to Ri'saad to secure a caravan alliance.
Player delivers moon sugar to Ri'saad and he agrees to the partnership.
Player returns to Tonilia and completes the quest, receiving gold and fence access.
